summary: TDD anchor coverage is solid across FunnelServiceTriggerTypeTest — all 10 mandated anchor tests are present, assertions are meaningful (business codes, not just status), and the pyramid balance (service-level integration tests for logic, FunnelControllerIT for HTTP contract) is correct. The migrated test files (FunnelServiceEmitEventTest, FunnelServiceKeyboardStepTest, FunnelServiceKeywordTest) are correctly updated to the List<TriggerDto> model and are not weakened. One HIGH finding: FunnelControllerIT retains a legacy test (`invalidTriggerValueWithSpaceReturns422`) that sends a flat `"triggerValue"` field now silently ignored by `@JsonIgnoreProperties(ignoreUnknown=true)` — the test will fail when run (expects 422, gets 200). One MEDIUM finding: the tech-spec explicitly requires the IT-level separation of 'intra-funnel at most one on_start' vs 'cross-funnel duplicate on_start value' as distinct cases in FunnelControllerIT; the intra-funnel case (CODE_MULTIPLE_ON_START) lives only in the service test, not in FunnelControllerIT as an HTTP-level test.

findings.description: This test sends `Map.of("name", "Draft", "triggerValue", "has space", "steps", ...)` with no `triggers` array. Since `UpdateFunnelRequest` has `@JsonIgnoreProperties(ignoreUnknown=true)`, the flat `triggerValue` field is silently dropped; the absent `triggers` normalizes to a single bare `on_start("")` inside `applyTriggers`. The request succeeds (200 OK), but the test asserts `status().isUnprocessableEntity()` + code `funnel_invalid_trigger_value`. The test will FAIL when Task 11 runs the full suite.
findings.impact: A pre-Phase-8 regression guarantee (reject invalid trigger value via HTTP) is now exercised only by FunnelServiceTriggerTypeTest at the service layer; the HTTP-level check is uncovered and the old test gives a false signal.
findings.fix: Replace the flat `"triggerValue"` body with a proper triggers array: `"triggers", List.of(Map.of("triggerType", "on_start", "triggerValue", "has space"))`. The on_start value `"has space"` should be rejected by `normalizeOnStartValue` → 422 `funnel_invalid_trigger_value`.

findings.description: Tech-spec Testing Strategy (Validation + DTO) explicitly requires: 'intra-funnel "at most one on_start"' vs 'cross-funnel duplicate on_start value → 422 split out as distinct cases' in FunnelControllerIT. The cross-funnel case is covered by `activateTriggerConflictReturns422` and `updateActiveFunnelToCollidingTriggerReturns422` (both check `funnel_trigger_conflict`). However, the intra-funnel 'two on_start elements in one PATCH body' case (CODE_MULTIPLE_ON_START) is tested only at the service level in FunnelServiceTriggerTypeTest, not at the HTTP level in FunnelControllerIT. The spec puts both in FunnelControllerIT to verify the HTTP stack (controller → service) transmits the correct code for each semantically distinct 422.
findings.impact: An HTTP-level regression in the intra-funnel on_start-count guard (e.g., a DTO layer silently dropping the second on_start) would go undetected by FunnelControllerIT.
findings.fix: Add a test in FunnelControllerIT (Phase 8 section): PATCH with `triggers = [onStartTriggerMap(""), onStartTriggerMap("x")]` → expect 422 + `$.code == "funnel_multiple_on_start"` (FunnelService.CODE_MULTIPLE_ON_START). Mirrors `patch_duplicateEventNameReturns422` in structure.

findings.description: The request body still carries `"triggerValue", ""` as a flat field that is now silently ignored. The test itself remains valid (it verifies step-count enforcement, which is unaffected), but the stale field is misleading documentation and should be cleaned up.
findings.impact: None on correctness; test will pass. Only a maintenance/clarity issue.
findings.fix: Remove `"triggerValue", ""` from the Map.of body (or replace with the triggers array if desired for explicitness).
